content: agent1: I am adding a named 'pattern' arg to str.first/str.last in crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs (only touching the fn first/last bodies at ~line 180-200, plus a new enum+helper placed just before 'impl Str' ... actually right after the existing helper fns near string_is_empty at the bottom of the file). agent1 -> agent2: we BOTH rewrite the signature+body+docs of Str::first and Str::last, so two different hunks = merge conflict. Git merges cleanly only if both patches contain IDENTICAL text for the overlapping region. Proposal: the final text of first() and last() (doc comments, signature, body) is one canonical version that BOTH of us paste verbatim; helpers live in non-adjacent places.

My side is done. My semantics: new `#[named] pattern: Option<Str>` (values alpha/numeric/alphanumeric/uppercase/lowercase/whitespace). Empty string -> "string is empty" checked FIRST; no match -> `no character matches pattern "alpha"`; unknown name -> `unknown pattern "x" (expected one of ...)`. Without pattern, unchanged (first/last grapheme). With pattern: scan graphemes forward (first) / backward (last), test the cluster's first char.

My helpers (private, at the bottom of str.rs right after `fn string_is_empty`): fn no_character_matches, fn unknown_char_class, enum CharClass {Alpha,...} with parse(&str)->StrResult<Self>, name(), matches(char), matches_cluster(&str). I will ALSO add one method to the first plain `impl Str` block (the one with locate/locate_opt, NOT the #[scope] block):
    fn pick_cluster(&self, from_back: bool, pattern: Option<&str>) -> StrResult<&str>
which does: parse pattern, empty check, find first/last cluster (matching the class if given), and returns the &str cluster or the errors above. So first/last bodies shrink to a delegation.

YOU please compose the canonical text since you know case semantics. Shape I suggest:

    pub fn first(
        &self,
        /// <my pattern doc, below>
        #[named]
        pattern: Option<Str>,
        /// <your case doc>
        #[named]
        case: Option<YourCaseType>,
    ) -> StrResult<Str> {
        let cluster = self.pick_cluster(false, pattern.as_deref())?;
        Ok(<your apply-case expression on cluster>)
    }
    (last identical with `true`)

My pattern param doc: "A character class that the extracted grapheme cluster must match. One of `{"alpha"}`, `{"numeric"}`, `{"alphanumeric"}`, `{"uppercase"}`, `{"lowercase"}` or `{"whitespace"}`." and fn doc paragraph: "If a `pattern` is given, returns the first (last) grapheme cluster whose first codepoint belongs to that character class instead. Fails with an error if there is no such cluster."
Please put your own helper enum/fn at the END of the file (after the `Replacement` cast! block), not near string_is_empty and not inside the impl blocks, so our insertions are never adjacent.

Reply with the exact canonical text of both functions (from the `/// Extracts the first grapheme cluster` doc line through the closing brace of `last`), and I will paste it byte-for-byte. Reply even if you disagree; if I hear nothing in a few minutes I will send you my own canonical text containing a guess at your case param instead.
